Description.SourceString: There is no better advert for red dragon leather than Fuzan. The tyrant of Umbral Sands has seen his fair share of upstarts. Moon Garou of all shapes and sizes have confronted him over the years, and none have managed to break his red leather hide. The only blades to have cut him were the claws of his mother, and the glaive of one mutinous KotHaar. Fuzan has met very little resistance over his long life, which might go some way to explaining why he is the way he is.
